Partners were assigned at random within each classroom and round. This
notebook checks that children's own characteristics do not predict the rank
of the partners they met, that rank differences are spread over the whole
session, and that every classroom and friendship group has enough variation
in rank gaps. Code: `code/si/S6_identification.R`.

```{r s6-setup}
```

## Three measures of exposure

The raw gap mixes the partner's rank with the child's own rank, so it is
not a clean balance check. The demeaned partner rank compares the partner
with the rank the child could expect in that classroom and round.

```{r s6-exposure}
```
